arithmetic_contract.psn: H[r,t,c]=sum_tau A[t,tau]*U[r,tau,c]+b[t], output theta_out*1[H>=theta_out]; fullrank A, no LIF reset
arithmetic_contract.initial_bound: |DeltaY[r,t,c]| <= |theta_in| * sum_g max_{j in g}|W[c,j]| * popcount((S XOR S_anchor)[r,t,g]); anchor Y retained as outward-rounded interval.
global_intervals: Propagate signed gamma and all entries of A conservatively; sup(I_H)<theta =>0; inf(I_H)>=theta =>theta
arithmetic_contract.fp_warning: 以上sum-of-squares表达仅用于数学证书，禁止替换原BN后称bit-exact。原cuBLAS/TF32点积、BN/Welford或reduce、rsqrt、PSN/addmm的误差均要向外包含。精化子矩阵可能选不同kernel，不能默认零宽结果等于原完整GEMM。全量回退必须真正原路径。
arithmetic_contract.monotonic_commit: 同一frame/层/weight/anchor版本下所有区间只能收紧；证明提交不可撤销。下一frame不得继承当前单调性。
